help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
help.faq1Body: The Services section shows a list of your active configs. You can see usage status, expiry date, subscription link, and details for each service.
help.faq2Title: How do I renew a service?
help.faq2Body: Open the details page of any service and choose Renew. Your wallet balance must be sufficient. If enabled, auto-renew can also be configured from the same page.
help.faq3Body: Manual card-to-card (with receipt upload), automatic card-to-card (SMS verification), and crypto payment (TRX/USDT/TON) are available in the Wallet section. Active methods vary based on bot settings.
help.faq4Body: From the Buy menu, choose your desired panel and plan. Your active discount (if any) is applied during checkout. After payment, the service is added to your services list.
help.faq5Body: The full history of deposits and payments is visible in the Wallet Transactions section. Each transaction's status (pending, approved, rejected) is also shown.
help.faq6Title: Signing in with a phone number or API key
help.faq6Body: If you're accessing this outside of Telegram, sign in with your phone number and an OTP code, or with an API key generated from your profile page. Inside the Telegram mini-app, a separate sign-in usually isn't needed.

guide.heading: {{type}} plan guide
guide.minWallet: A purchase needs at least {{amount}} in the wallet (change it in Settings).
guide.noMinWallet: No minimum wallet balance is set for buying (change it in Settings).

fixed.what: The reseller pays the plan price once and gets a set package: a given volume, a given number of days and a user limit. The total volume of the users they create is capped at the plan's volume, and the account expires when the days run out.
fields: User limit — optional; 0 means no limit
Admin role in the panel — required
buyer: Buy by paying the plan price once (discount codes work too)
Renew with this same plan only: the plan's days are added to the current expiry and its volume to the current volume; remaining days and volume are kept
Buy extra days, extra volume and extra users — each only when it has a price under Add-ons
auto: At the expiry date the account expires and the reseller's panel admin is disabled
If not renewed within {{grace}} days after expiry, the admin and all their users are deleted from the panel
notes: A price change only affects future purchases and renewals; current accounts are not affected
Disabling the plan only stops sales to new buyers; current holders can still renew with it
Extra users are permanent and are not lost on renewal

unlimited.what: The reseller pays the plan price once and uses the panel for a set number of days with no volume limit. The account expires when the days run out.
fields: User limit — optional; 0 means no limit
Admin role in the panel — required
buyer: Buy by paying the plan price once (discount codes work too)
Renew with this same plan only: the plan's days are added to the current expiry; remaining days are kept
Buy extra days and extra users — each only when it has a price under Add-ons
auto: At the expiry date the account expires and the reseller's panel admin is disabled
If not renewed within {{grace}} days after expiry, the admin and all their users are deleted from the panel
notes: A price change only affects future purchases and renewals; current accounts are not affected
Disabling the plan only stops sales to new buyers; current holders can still renew with it
There is no extra volume for this type, since the volume is unlimited

usage.what: Nothing is paid at purchase. Every minute, the traffic the reseller's users used is charged from the reseller's wallet (price per GB × traffic used). No expiry and no renewal.
fields: Price per GB used (Toman) — above zero
Total traffic cap (GB) — optional; 0 means unlimited
User limit — optional; 0 means no limit
Admin role in the panel — required
buyer: Set a usage cap for themselves so they never spend more than they want
See the usage report and every wallet charge in detail
Buy extra users, when it has a price under Add-ons
auto: Every minute the cost of the traffic used is charged from the reseller's wallet
When the wallet runs out the account is suspended and the panel admin disabled; after a top-up it is switched back on automatically
The reseller is warned when the balance covers less than {{lowHours}} hours
When usage reaches the reseller's own cap, the account is disabled automatically
notes: A change of the price per GB applies at once to all active accounts on this plan
The plan price at purchase is zero; only usage is charged

hourly.what: Nothing is paid at purchase. For every hour the reseller's account is active, the cost is charged minute by minute from the reseller's wallet; traffic used does not affect the cost. No expiry and no renewal.
fields: Price per active hour (Toman) — above zero
Total traffic cap (GB) — optional; 0 means unlimited
User limit — optional; 0 means no limit
Admin role in the panel — required
buyer: Pause the account (when the Pause / resume button is on for this panel); nothing is charged while it is paused
See the usage report and every wallet charge in detail
Buy extra users, when it has a price under Add-ons
auto: Every minute the cost of the active time is charged from the reseller's wallet
When the wallet runs out the account is suspended and the panel admin disabled; after a top-up it is switched back on automatically
The reseller is warned when the balance covers less than {{lowHours}} hours
notes: A change of the price per hour applies at once to all active accounts on this plan
The traffic cap only limits the users' total volume; it does not affect the cost

guide.title: How does this plan work?
guide.payFixed: You pay {{price}} once, up front, and get {{volume}} of volume for {{days}} days.
guide.payUnlimited: You pay {{price}} once, up front, and get {{days}} days with unlimited volume.
guide.payUsage: No upfront fee. {{rate}} is taken from your wallet for every gigabyte your users use. Charges run every minute and only for real usage.
guide.payHourly: No upfront fee. {{rate}} is taken from your wallet for every hour the panel is active; charges run every minute, pro rata, whether or not your users use traffic. Nothing is charged while you pause the panel.
guide.payLegacy: You pay once, up front, for the volume you choose at purchase ({{rate}}).
guide.liveRate: The rate is always read from the plan; if it changes, the new rate applies from that moment on.
guide.priceLocked: A later price change does not affect this purchase; it only applies to future renewals.
guide.minWallet: You need at least {{amount}} in your wallet to buy this plan.
guide.volumeFixed: Your users share a total volume of {{volume}}.
guide.volumeUnlimited: Volume is unlimited; there is no cap on your users' total usage.
guide.volumeCap: Your users' total usage is capped at {{volume}}.
guide.volumeNoCapUsage: There is no volume cap; whatever is used is charged.
guide.volumeChosen: The volume is the amount you choose at purchase.
guide.usageCap: You can set your own usage cap; when usage reaches it, the panel pauses automatically so costs stop growing.
guide.usersLimited: You can create up to {{count}} users.
guide.usersUnlimited: There is no limit on the number of users.
guide.expires: After {{days}} days the panel expires and is disabled.
guide.graceRenew: After expiry you have {{grace}} days to renew; otherwise your admin and all of its users are permanently removed from the panel.
guide.graceRenewOrDays: After expiry you have {{grace}} days to renew or buy extra days; otherwise your admin and all of its users are permanently removed from the panel.
guide.graceDaysOnly: After expiry you have {{grace}} days to buy extra days; otherwise your admin and all of its users are permanently removed from the panel.
guide.graceOnly: After expiry there is a {{grace}}-day grace period, then your admin and all of its users are permanently removed from the panel.
guide.noExpiryWallet: It does not expire; the panel stays active as long as your wallet has balance.
guide.walletEmpty: If your wallet can't cover the next charge, the panel is suspended automatically (users are not deleted) and re-enabled automatically after you top up.
guide.renewRule: Renewed only with this same plan at its current price ({{price}}). Each renewal adds {{days}} days to the current expiry; remaining days are kept, and an expired panel counts from the renewal day.
guide.renewVolume: Each renewal also adds {{volume}} on top of the current volume; unused volume and bought extra volume are kept.
guide.renewNoReset: Nothing resets on renewal: users, the user limit and bought add-ons stay as they are.
guide.noRenew: No renewal needed; this plan does not expire and keeps running while you have balance.
guide.addonDays: Extra days: {{price}} per day. Added to the expiry date; can be bought after expiry too (during the grace period) and re-enables the panel.
guide.addonVolume: Extra volume: {{price}} per GB. Added on top of the current volume and kept on renewal. An expired panel must be renewed first.
guide.addonUsers: Extra users: {{price}} per user. Raises the user limit permanently.
guide.addonUsersRenewable: Extra users: {{price}} per user. Raises the user limit permanently and is kept on renewal.
guide.addonsPermanent: All add-ons are permanent and carry over to the next period on renewal.

addon.noteDays: Days are added to the current expiry; if the panel has expired they count from now and the panel is re-enabled.
addon.noteVolume: This volume is added on top of the current volume and is kept on renewal.
addon.noteUsers: The user limit is raised permanently.
addon.noteUsersRenewable: The user limit is raised permanently and is kept on renewal.

renew.noPlan: This reseller's plan was not found; please contact support.
renew.ownPlanOnly: Renewal is always with the plan you bought, at that plan's current price.
renew.disabledPlan: This plan is no longer sold to new buyers, but you can still renew it.
renew.nothingResets: The plan's days and volume are added to what you have; nothing resets, and users and add-ons stay as they are.
